objective: Create and persist a strict versioned DesignPlan from confirmed requirements and curated evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Strict runtime schema/semantic validation rejects altered requirements, evidence versions, output bindings and unknown plan fields.
Plan covers tables, relationships, measures, pages, visuals, filters and explicit no-RLS intent.
Browser creates and exposes a source-bound plan with JSON download; edits invalidate it.
out_of_scope: Power BI generation and runtime verification
LLM interpretation, cloud services and commercial backlog
actual_authenticated_actor: Codex implementation execution via haseebulhaque authenticated GitHub connection
dependencies: Merged APBRA-130 requirements and APBRA-131 curated adapter; APBRA-133 consumes validated plan
